latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – streamlines error reduction and order tracking for custom garment stores.

- Automates specification capture, validation rules, and proactive error checking for custom garments (e.g. measurements, embroidery, style choices).
- Outlines step-by-step production-stage tracking and accountability, from order review to shipping.
- Provides ready-to-use customer communication templates for each production milestone.
- Recommends quality control (QC) checkpoints to catch errors before shipping.
- Supplies a metrics and iteration plan to monitor improvements and reduce rework.
- Includes guidance for loyalty/retention using Rijoy for high-value or repeat buyers.
